title: Eight weeks of plyometric training for a professional volleyball athlete four months post-knee arthroscopy and bone repair: a case report
core_idea: Demonstrate the application of an 8-week plyometric exercise program to target improvement of knee muscle strength, power, and vertical jump performance in a 20-year-old professional volleyball athlete four months after arthroscopic removal and repair of left knee osteophytes during the return-to-sport phase.
tldr: Case report of an 8-week plyometric program used during return-to-sport for a 20-year-old professional volleyball player four months post-knee arthroscopy, aiming to restore knee strength, power, and vertical jump ability.
